name: Horror Style 3D Sound Scene
author: Willow74
description: I made this for the Moving Sounds Challenge in the Unity course. I got a bit side-tracked and decided to alter the environment so that I could make the game more horror based. I also used a bit of scripting to delay certain sounds which play throughout the game such as the door knock and certain car sounds. I also added a few models of my own into this to make it a bit more personal. The clown was made by myself a few years back and the artwork at the back wall was some college art my girlfriend made a few years ago which I found on my computer. I'm quite impressed with what I managed to make in the end and spent a lot longer on this than I was probably meant to. Feel free to share your thoughts and please go easy on me as I am very new to Unity.
